To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the induction of steraoyl-CoA delta-9 desaturase gene expression by peroxisomal proliferators is due to an increase of transcription of the SDC1 gene and is mediated by peroxisone proliferator-activated receptors.

clofibrate and gemfibrozil induce mouse SCD1 gene transcription and mRNA accumulation, and that the cis-linked response element of the mouse SCD1 promoter for PPARs is localized to an AGGACA sequence between base pairs-664 to -642.
peroxisomal proliferator-activated receptors are the mediators of peroxisome proliferation-induced stearoyl-coenzyme A desaturase gene expression.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification and characterization of the genes that are regulated by the nuclear receptor, PPAR.
the identification of cis-linked regulatory elements and trans-acting factors that control the expression of the SCD gene.
the regulation of SCD1 gene transcription by peroxisomal proliferators and polyunsaturated fatty acid.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
peroxisomal proliferator-activated receptors regulate the transcription of the mouse stearoyl-coenzyme A desaturase gene.
peroxisomal proliferators induce SCD1 gene transcription by a PPAR-dependent pathway.
peroxisomal proliferators are able to induce the expression of SCD1 gene through PPAR activation, which in turn increases the transcription of SCD1.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
SCD1 gene is a direct target for the PPARs and the induction by clofibrate is mediated by PPARs.

SCD1 gene transcription is induced by peroxisomal proliferators and polyunsaturated fatty acid (PUFA) levels in a PPAR-dependent manner, and that the induction of SCD mRNA by peroxisomes is inhibited by cyclohexamide.
peroxisomal proliferator activated receptor (PPAR)-mediated induction of stearolyl CoA desaturase is a novel mechanism by which PPARs regulate lipid metabolism.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the SCD1 enzyme is induced by peroxisomal proliferators.
SCD1 is a target for PPAR activation, which may be important for peroxisomal proliferation and/or the regulation of fatty acid homeostasis.
peroxisomal proliferators induce SCD1 gene transcription by binding to PPARs.
